items.claim: README example makes a new `share` object every render, so the brush tools are redefined every render
items.note: `shareBrushSize` now returns one cached, frozen share for each pair of size option and key, so the README example is correct as written. This is the general fix: I changed the helper itself rather than only the README, so anyone who calls it during a render gets a stable share.

items.claim: A step blocked by the brush's own bound now writes nothing
Shared size clamped to the first tool's bounds in a prefs-backed store
items.note: (B). The shared leaf now takes the widest `min`, `max`, and `endless` of every tool naming the key, and each tool clamps the value when it reads it. A scratch test against a real `createPrefsStore` passed: the max-400 brush read 120 and the max-30 brush read 30. That test was deleted afterward, and the committed test checks the shared leaf's bounds.

items.claim: `shareBrushSize` put a world-unit size under the pixel key and accepted an empty key
items.note: (B). It now throws in both cases. Passing a key of its own is the override. This is my strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md` under "Audit round thirty-seven (2026-11-18): brush".
